title: HORNS OF OBSIDIAN // THE UNICORN STAMPEDE
narrative: Through the dense pine forests of Skagos, an ambush of sixty shaggy mountain wildlings wielding obsidian-tipped axes sprang from the mist. Davos gripped the braided mane of his mount: a nine-foot woolly beast with a single spiraled horn of pure obsidian jutting from its forehead. Shaggydog, Rickon Stark's colossal black direwolf, leaped over a deadfall tree, ripping out the throat of the clan chieftain. With a terrifying roar, the herd of armored Skagosi unicorns charged downhill, their horns piercing through hide and bone, shattering the wildling war party into retreat.
resolvesPlotHole: The Mythological Existence of Skagosi Unicorns
